correctness.rationale: The exact weight w(n,d)=C(n-1,d)p^[d(d+1)/2]q^[n-1-d] follows from incident-edge counting and independent clique edges. Uniform log-weight error o(n log n) gives a rigorous one-dimensional Laplace principle and full conditional LDP, with boundary minimizer checked for c<=1 and interior minimizer for c>1. Conditioning on neighbors leaves the non-clique-constrained edges independent, so a binomial Chernoff union bound proves every unmarked normalized degree tends to one. The exact finite verifier passed 70 assertions across exhaustive graphs n=2..6 and five c-parameter convergence tests. Computation does not establish the infinite limit.

value.rationale: A simplicial vertex is a natural local structural feature tied to chordal elimination; the near-complete G(n,p) benchmark offers a natural competition between deleting marked incident edges and forcing edges among its neighbors. The resulting variational law has an exact critical c=1, a C1/non-C2 rare-event rate, all-macroscopic-degree large deviations, and a tagged-only defect while other vertices remain asymptotically full-degree. This phase classification is more than an arbitrary finite computation or algebraic rephrasing.
